Source control assertions use existing FerroUI mock-window/dispatcher, real controls and automation providers; all 65 combined canvas/toolbar scenarios are covered.

Toolbar orchestration, targets, palettes/resources and erase-all behavior use FerroUI. All four exact registration regressions pass in the full controls run at 7fbffd0; framework diagnostics log rejected additions.
